hook: Your iPhone, as a second Mac display.
hookText: iPhone as a second Mac screen

beats.say: PocketDisplayJoe turns an iPhone into an extra monitor for a MacBook or Mac mini, over USB or Wi-Fi.
It creates a virtual display sized to the phone at sixty frames per second, streamed with hardware HEVC. Touch works as a mouse.
It's native Swift and SwiftUI, about two thousand five hundred lines, with no accounts, no cloud and no analytics.
